verses.sanskrit: ते सेने शिबिरं गत्वा न्यविशेतां विशांपते।  यथाभागं यथान्यायं यथागुल्म च सर्वशः॥१॥
कृत्वाऽवहारं सैन्यानां द्रोणः परमदुर्मनाः।  दुर्योधनमभिप्रेक्ष्य सव्रीडमिदमब्रवीत्॥२॥
उक्तमेतन्मया पूर्वं न तिष्ठति धनञ्जये। शक्यो ग्रहीतुं संग्रामे देवैरपि युधिष्ठिरः॥३॥
verses.english: ‘I have told you before, that when Dhananjaya stays by the side of Yudhishthira, even the celestials will not be able to capture the latter in battle.

verses.sanskrit: इति तद्वः प्रयततां कृतं पार्थेन संयुगे।  मा विशङ्कीर्वचो मह्यमजेयौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ॥४॥
verses.english: You all assaulted Partha in battle, but he defeated all of you; do not doubt my words; Krishna and the son of Pandu are incapable of being vanquished in battle.

verses.sanskrit: अपनीते तु योगेन केनचिच्छ्वेतवाहने।  तत एष्यति ते राजन् वशमेष युधिष्ठिरः॥५॥
कश्चिदाहूय तं संङ्ख्ये देशमन्यं प्रकर्षतु।  तमजित्वा न कौन्तेयो निवर्तेत कथंचन॥६॥
verses.english: Let some one challenging him (Arjuna) in battle take him to another part of the field. The son of Kunti will not return without having vanquished him.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शून्ये धर्मराजमहं नृप।  ग्रहीष्यामि चमूं भित्त्वा धृष्टद्युम्नस्य पश्यतः॥७॥
अर्जुनेन विहीनस्तु यदि नोत्सृजते रणम्।  मामुपायान्तमालोक्य गृहीतं विद्धि पाण्डवम्॥८॥
verses.english: Thus, O monarch, I will today with certitude bring under your control Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, with all his followers.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तेऽहं महाराज धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्।  समानेष्यामि सगणं वशमद्य न संशयः॥९॥
यदि तिष्ठति संग्रामे मुहूर्तमपि पाण्डवः।  अथापयाति संग्रामाद्विजयात्तद्विशिष्यते॥१०॥
verses.english: If, in battle, that son of Pandu stays only for one moment (before me) then I will bring him (a captive) from the field; surely that achievement will be more advantage than victory over the hostile army.'

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              द्रोणस्य तद्वचः श्रुत्वा त्रिगर्ताधिपतिस्तदा।  भ्रातृभिः सहितो राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥११॥
वयं विनिकुता राजन् सदा गाण्डीवधन्वना।  अनागःस्वपि चागस्तत्कृतमस्मासु तेन वै॥१२॥
ते वयं स्मरमाणास्तान् विनिकारान् पृथग्विधान्।  कोधाग्निना दह्यमाना नशेमहि सदा निशि॥१३॥
verses.english: We, remembering those various occasions of humiliation, are ever consumed with the fire of wrath and at night can never enjoy sleep.

verses.sanskrit: स नो दिष्ट्यास्त्रसम्पन्नश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः।  कर्तारः स्म वयं कर्म यच्चिकीर्षाम हृद्गतम्॥१४॥
verses.english: By good fortune it is that Arjuna bearing arms, will become the object of our sight; so we will achieve that feat which our hearts long to accomplish.

verses.sanskrit: भवतश्च प्रियं यत्स्यादस्माकं च यशस्करम्।  वयमेनं हनिष्यामो निकृष्यायोधनाद्बहिः॥१५॥
अद्यास्त्वनर्जुना भूमिरत्रिगर्ताऽथ वा पुनः।  सत्यं ते प्रतिजानीमो नैतन्मिथ्या भविष्यति॥१६॥
verses.english: Today the earth will be relieved of the burden of Arjuna or that of the Trigarttas. Truly we resolve this before you and this our resolution will never be falsified?

verses.sanskrit: एवं सत्यरथश्चोक्त्वा सत्यवर्मा च भारत।  सत्यव्रतश्च सत्येषुः सत्यकर्मा तथैव च॥१७॥
verses.english: Satyaratha, Satyavarman, Satyavrata, Satyashu and Satyakarman, O Bharata, having spoken in the same manner. Those five brothers, with their ten thousand cars, retired, O monarch, having taken that oath on the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit: सहिता भ्रातरः पञ्च रथानामयुतेन च।  न्यवर्तन्त महाराज कृत्वा शपथमाहवे॥१८॥
मालवास्तुण्डिकेराश्च रथानामयुतैस्त्रिभिः।  सुशर्मा च नरव्याघ्रस्त्रिगर्तः प्रस्थलाधिपः॥१९॥
verses.english: The Malavas and the Tundikeras, with thirty thousand cars and that foremost of men Susharman of the Trigartta race, the ruler of Prasthala together with the Mavelakas the Lalithyas and the Madrakas and with ten thousand cars and accompanied by his biothers.

verses.sanskrit: मावेल्लकैर्ललित्थैश्च सहितो मद्रकैरपि।  रथानामयुतेनैव सोऽगमद्भातृभिः सह॥२०॥
नानाजनपदेभ्यश्च रथानामयुतं पुनः।  समुत्थितं विशिष्टानां शपथार्थमुपागमत्॥२१॥
ततो ज्वलनमानर्च्य हुत्वा सर्वे पृथक् पृथक्।  जगृहुः कुशचीराणि चित्राणि कवचानि च॥२२॥
ते च बद्धतनुत्राणा घृताक्ताः कुशचीरिणः।  मौर्वीमेखलिनो वीराः सहस्रशतदक्षिणाः॥२३॥
यज्वानः पुत्रिणो लोक्याः कृतकृत्यास्तनुत्यजः।  योक्ष्यमाणास्तदाऽऽत्मानं यशसा विजयेन च॥२४॥
verses.english: Who had accomplished many sacrifices, who had been blessed with sons, who deserved regions of bliss hereinafter, who had done what ought to be done, who were ready to lay down their bodies, who had devoted their souls to the acquirement of fame and victory.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यश्रुतिमुखैः क्रतुभिश्चाप्तद‌क्षिणैः।  प्राप्यान् लोकान् सुयुद्धेन क्षिप्रमेव यियासवः॥२५॥
verses.english: Who were intent speedily on going to the regions, by being killed in a fair fight, that are attained my means of sacrifices attended with profuse Dakshinas, and by means also of many such other rites, the foremost of which are Brahmacharya and the study of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणांस्तर्पयित्वा च निष्कान् दत्त्वा पृथक् पृथक्।  गाश्च वासांसि च पुनः समाभाष्य परस्परम्॥२६॥
verses.english: Those heroes having gratified the Brahmanas by giving them golden coin separately and also kine and garments and having addressed one another in loving words, and having kindled the fire, took that oath in the field of battle; then in the presence of that fire they took that oath with a great firmness of resolution.
verses.bhavadeepa: ब्रह्मचर्यं वेदव्रताचरणं श्रुतिर्वेदाध्ययनं ते एव मुखं प्रधानं येषु तैः कर्मभिरिति शेषः ॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्वाल्य कृष्णवर्त्मानमुपागम्य रणव्रतम्।  तस्मिन्नग्नौ तदा चक्रुः प्रतिज्ञां दृढनिश्चयाः॥२७॥
शृण्वतां सर्वभूतानामुच्चैर्वाचो बभाषिरे।  सर्वे धनञ्जयवधे प्रतिज्ञां चापि चक्रिरे॥२८॥
ये वै लोकाश्चाव्रतिनां ये चैव ब्रह्मघातिनाम्।  मद्यपस्य च ये लोका गुरुदाररतस्य च॥२९॥
ब्रह्मस्वहारिणश्चैव राजपिण्डापहारिणः।  शरणागतं च त्यजतो याचमानं तथा घ्नतः॥३०॥
अगारदाहिनां चैव ये च गां निघ्नतामपि।  अपकारिणां च ये लोका ये च ब्रह्मद्विषामपि॥३१॥
स्वभार्यामृतुकालेषु मोहाद्वै नाभिगच्छताम्।  श्राद्धमैथुनिकानां च ये चाप्यात्मापहारिणाम्॥३२॥
verses.english: Thosc regions that are for the liars, those that are for the Brahminicides, those that are for the drunkards, those that are for a person who has illicit intercourse with the wife of his preceptor. Those that are for him who robs a Brahmana of his property or for him who enjoys the king's allowance (without fulfiling the conditions thereof) or for him who forsakes one seeking shelter in him or for him who slays one asking for favours. Those regions that are for the incendiary, or for the slayer of the kine, or for him that does injury to others or for him thai nourishes ill-will against the Brahınanas. Those regions that are for him who, out of foolishness, does not hold sexual intercourse with his wife during her season, those also that are for men who indulge in sexual intercourse on the day they have to perform a Shraddha, those that are for people who injure their own soul; those that are for men who appropriate things deposited with them out of trust or for those who destroy knowledge or for those who fight with the eunuchs or for those that follow thic mean; those regions that are for the atheists or those that arc for people who abandon the Fires and their own mother or those that are for the sinful,-those regions shall be ours. If we return from the field of battle without having slain Dhananjaya or if afflicted by him we, out of terror, turn away our faces from the field.

verses.sanskrit: न्यासापहारिणां ये च श्रुतं नाशयतां च ये।  क्लीबेन युध्यमानानां ये च नीचानुसारिणाम्॥३३॥
नास्तिकानां च ये लोका येऽग्निमातृपितृत्यजाम्।  तानाप्नुयामहे लोकान् ये च पापकृतामपि॥३४॥
यद्यहत्वा वयं युद्धे निवर्तेम धनञ्जयम्।  तेन चाभ्यर्दितास्त्रासाद्भवेम हि पराङ्मुखाः॥३५॥
यदि त्वसुकरं लोके कर्म कुर्याम संयुगे।  इषाँल्लोकान् प्राप्नुयामो वयमद्य न संशयः॥३६॥
एवमुक्त्वा तदा राजंस्तेऽभ्यवर्तन्त संयुगे।  आह्वयन्तोऽर्जुनं वीराः पितृजुष्टां दिशं प्रति॥३७॥
आहूतस्तैर्नरव्याघ्रैः पार्थः परपुरञ्जयः।  धर्मराजमिदं वाक्यमपदान्तरमब्रवीत्॥३८॥
verses.english: That foremost of men, that conqueror of hostile fortresses, namely the son of Pritha, being summoned by them, said these words without delay to the very virtuous king Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: आहूतो न निवर्तेयमिति मे व्रतमाहितम्।  संशप्तकाश्च मां राजन्नाह्वयन्ति महामृधे॥३९॥
verses.english: 'Challenged, I will never turn back. This is my firm resolution. These Samshaptakas (those who are sworn to die or to conquer) O king, are calling me to meet them in battle.

verses.sanskrit: एष च भ्रातृभिः सार्धं सुशर्माऽह्वयते रणे। वधाय सगणस्यास्य मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥४०॥
verses.english: This Susarman with his brothers is summoning me to battle. It behoves you to permit me to slay him and his followers.

verses.sanskrit: नैतच्छक्नोमि संसोढुमाह्वानं पुरुषर्षभ।  सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि हतान् विद्धि परान् युधि॥४१॥
verses.english: O foremost of men, I cannot brook this challenge; I do tell you truly, know these hostile heroes to be already slain in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              श्रुतं ते तत्त्वतस्तात यद्द्रोणस्य चिकीर्षितम्।  यथा तदनृतं तस्य भवेत् तत्त्वं समाचर॥४२॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said O child, you are perfectly aware of what Drona is intent on doing. Act in such a manner so that his intention may be frustrated.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणो हि बलवान् शूरः कृतास्त्रश्च जितश्रमः। प्रतिज्ञातं च तेनैतङ्ग्रहणं मे महारथ॥४३॥

अर्जुन उवाच।
              अयं वै सत्यजिद्राजन्नद्य त्वां रक्षिता युधि।  ध्रियमाणे च पाञ्चाल्ये नाचार्यः काममाप्स्यति॥४४॥
verses.english: Arjuna said This Satyajit, O monarch, will protect you in battle today; and so long as the prince of the Panchalas lives, the preceptor will not attain the fruition of his desires,

verses.sanskrit: हते तु पुरुषव्याघ्रे रणे सत्यजिति प्रभो।  सर्वैरपि समेतैर्वा न स्थातव्यं कथञ्चन॥४५॥

सञ्जय उवाच।
              अनुज्ञातस्ततो राज्ञा परिष्वक्तश्च फाल्गुनः।  प्रेम्णा दृष्टश्च बहुधा ह्याशिषश्चास्य योजिताः॥४६॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Then king Yudhishthira gave Phalguna the permission he sought; and embraced him and cast affectionate glances him and pronounced numerous benedictions on him.

verses.sanskrit: विहायैनं ततः पार्थस्त्रिगर्तान् प्रत्ययाद्बली।  क्षुधितः क्षुद्विघातार्थं सिंहो मृगगणानिव॥४७॥
verses.english: Having made these arrangement, puissant son of Pritha went to meet the Trigarttas, like a hungry lion falling upon a herd of deer, for assuaging its hunger.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दौर्योधनं सैन्यं मुदा परमया युतम्।  ऋतेऽर्जुनं भृशं क्रुद्धं धर्मराजस्य निग्रहे॥४८॥
ततोऽन्योन्येन ते सैन्ये समाजग्मतुरोजसा।  गङ्गासरय्वौ वेगेन प्रावृषीवोल्बणोदके॥४९॥
